purpose: Consultant-facing update after the March 25 scorer patch and March 26 U2AF2 follow-up work.

current_working_baseline.name: handoff-floor-1.0
current_working_baseline.status: new strongest real rule-based scorer baseline on the working branch

comparison_to_exomiser.bottom_line: Genovy now beats Exomiser on ranking quality metrics in the real scorer run, but still trails on recall.

important_caveat.meaning: The real 1.0 scorer patch is stronger globally, but it is not perfectly clean. Source-model fragile genes can still be harmed by a broad scorer change.

summary: The benchmark may identify a possible gap.
The benchmark may not author truth.
Never add a term because it helps a case.
Never cheat a gene to a higher rank.
Always separate seam repair from disease-profile enrichment.
All benchmark-tail enrichment must stay shadow-only until it is independently source-backed and validated.
anti_overfit_policy.reason: We do not want benchmark-tail cleanup to pollute the knowledge graph.

u2af2_follow_up.current_read: U2AF2 is a support-seam problem first, not an enrichment-first problem.
why: The syndrome node exists in the graph as MONDO:0957810 / OMIM:620535 with phenotype annotations.
The key seam is still weak or missing: a stable robust U2AF2 -> disease support path.
Disease-profile enrichment alone does not rescue the truth gene under the current support geometry.

PMID_36747105_proband.current_read: mostly seam/support fragility, not mainly missing disease terms

shadow_enrichment_tests.name: public_source_shadow
shadow_enrichment_tests.meaning: Public-source-backed disease-profile enrichment alone did nothing.

shadow_enrichment_tests.name: manual_omim_shadow
source_basis: manual browser extraction from OMIM 191318 and OMIM 620535
shadow_enrichment_tests.meaning: Even stricter OMIM-backed disease-profile enrichment still did nothing under the current support geometry.

u2af2_follow_up.conclusion: U2AF2 should not be treated as just another thin branch like STXBP1. The next U2AF2 step is support-seam repair, not more phenotype-term chasing.

what_we_learned: The 1.0 disease-to-gene handoff rule unlocked a real global scorer bottleneck.
The rule is strong enough to beat Exomiser on ranking metrics in the real benchmark run.
The U2AF2 regression proves that some genes remain structurally fragile even when the global scorer improves.
Two negative shadow-enrichment tests on U2AF2 show that enrichment-first is the wrong ordering for that gene.
The project now has an explicit anti-overfit curation rule to prevent benchmark-driven graph pollution.

recommended_next_step.priority_1: Inspect and repair the U2AF2 -> MONDO:0957810 support seam / bridge.
recommended_next_step.priority_2: Only after seam repair, revisit whether phenotype enrichment still adds value for U2AF2.
recommended_next_step.priority_3: Keep the 1.0 scorer as the current working baseline while tracking the U2AF2 caveat explicitly.
